premises.text: Surgeons need to see the patient's anatomy through skin and tissue during surgery
premises.evidence_span: Imagine, what if surgeons had X-ray vision and they could see their patient's anatomy through skin and tissue.

premises.text: Current surgical navigation systems are uncomfortable and not intuitive for surgeons

premises.text: A device can project a patient's anatomy in real time directly onto the surgeon's retina
